# entrepot_service_account (Resource)

A service account: a non-human principal for automation. It authenticates with `entrepot_service_account_token` tokens and is granted access with `entrepot_role_binding` (`subject_type = "user"`, `subject = entrepot_service_account.<x>.username`). Deleting a service account revokes its tokens.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "entrepot_service_account" "ci" {
  name        = "ci"
  description = "CI publisher"
}

# Use the username ("sa:ci") as a role binding subject.
output "ci_username" {
  value = entrepot_service_account.ci.username
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service account name (without the `sa:` prefix). Changing it forces a new service account.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description (the account's display name). The API cannot update service accounts, so changing it forces a new service account (and new tokens).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `name`.
- `user_id` (String) Server-assigned user ID.
- `username` (String) Username to use as a role binding subject: `sa:<name>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Service accounts are imported by name (with or without the "sa:" prefix).
terraform import entrepot_service_account.ci ci
```
